source: 지원은 금요일까지 초안을 보낼 예정이지만 최종 승인은 아직 받지 못했습니다. 검토자가 답변하기 전에는 완료된 작업으로 표시하지 마세요.
check: No invented gender; planned Friday draft, final approval not received, no completion label before reviewer response.

source: The revised estimate is 12.5% lower, but delivery is two days later. Keep the original order open until the client explicitly accepts both changes.
check: Both cost reduction and later delivery; original order stays open until explicit acceptance of both.

source: The smaller sample suggests an improvement, but it does not establish the cause. Please include the unsuccessful trials in the summary and avoid describing this result as a guarantee.
check: Retain limited evidence, unknown cause, inclusion of failures, no guarantee; useful rewording.

source: 제안해 주신 일정은 확인했습니다. 다만 목요일 오후에는 참석하기 어려우니, 가능하시다면 금요일 오전으로 조정해 주시면 감사하겠습니다.
check: Polite conditional request; Thursday afternoon unavailable, Friday morning preferred; no claim of agreement.

source: The flag `review_only` must remain enabled. Do not change the stored value from 0.75 to 75, even when the interface displays a percentage.
check: Exact flag, enabled obligation, numbers 0.75 and 75 and prohibition retained.

source: 문제가 해결됐을 수도 있지만 아직 재현 시험을 완료하지 않았습니다. 오늘 오후 3시까지 오류가 다시 나타나지 않더라도 최종 성공으로 보고하지 마세요.
check: Possible resolution not certainty; reproduction test incomplete; no final success even absent error through 3pm today.
